title: Demo-ready optional external application setup, version 1
description: No setup file is required for the four owned demos. Tokens and Credits is an optional managed local application without an azd requirement. Patriots remains an explicit link-only integration. Never add credentials, connection strings, or tokens.

version.description: Setup file contract version. Only version 1 is supported.

repositories.description: Every identity is optional. Legacy bundled identity entries cannot redirect deployment outside this repository.

defra.description: Legacy key. Only this checkout's src/PublicSectorAgentDemos.Demo2.Act path is accepted. Its environment comes from the presentation base.

assuranceBoard.description: Legacy key. Only this checkout's src/PublicSectorAgentDemos.Demo3.Coordinate path is accepted. Its environment comes from the presentation base.

patriots.description: Optional external azure-ai-mgs-patriots checkout. IncludePatriots enables a link only, not deployment or process ownership.

path.description: Absolute path to the optional tokens-and-credits Git checkout. Startup builds and starts only its local web project. No azd environment or cloud settings belong here.
Absolute path to the external Git repository working tree.

azdEnvironment.description: Optional azd environment name. Omit it to use the single default environment.
